_about: ElevenLabs Music spec for Ghost Duels (tools/elevenlabs_music.py): one entry per music track. 'file' is where the looped pick goes in the game. Direction: README.md, 'Sound direction v3'.

tracks.name: base
tracks.role: Base game background music, loops for as long as the game is open. v4 (2026-11-10): polished cinematic slot score for the adult-cartoon crypt with the duels, replacing the carousel waltz.
tracks.prompt: Loopable background music for a premium online slot game set in a torch-lit pirate crypt where ghost captains duel, 120 seconds, A minor, 100 BPM, 4/4. Polished cinematic adventure score with a dark-fantasy pirate swagger: a memorable minor-key hook on celesta and plucked harp, answered by a low cello and bass-clarinet line; steady low taiko and frame-drum groove with soft shakers; warm pizzicato strings; now and then a short French horn phrase, a soft pipe organ chord and a wordless ghost choir 'ooh'. Spooky and mysterious but classy and fun, never horror, never scary. Constant medium energy, no big build-ups, no drops, so it can loop for an hour without tiring. Clean modern mix, leaves room in the upper mids for game chimes. Seamless loop: the end flows back into the beginning. Instrumental only.

tracks.name: freespins
tracks.role: Ghost Crates free spins, v5 direction A (2026-11-10): acoustic orchestral, the base track's world, more exciting. The v4 take sounded like a rave.
tracks.prompt: Loopable free-spins music for a premium pirate ghost crypt slot game, 60 seconds, A minor, 6/8 swashbuckling gallop at about 116 BPM. A thrilling orchestral treasure hunt through a haunted crypt: driving string ostinato in the cellos and violas, bold French horn and trumpet melody with a catchy minor-key hook, galloping taiko and orchestral snare, celesta and harp sparkles answering the horns, a wordless ghost choir swelling on the big phrases, a short pipe organ chord at the turnarounds. Exciting and rewarding, full of adventure and anticipation, steady high energy without breakdowns. No electronic music: no synths, no synth bass, no EDM or four-on-the-floor kick, no claps, no dance beat, nothing like a rave. Not cartoonish: no tuba, no accordion. Spooky but classy, never horror. Clean modern film-score mix with room for game sounds. Seamless loop: the end flows back into the beginning. Instrumental only.

tracks.name: freespins_b
tracks.role: Ghost Crates free spins, v5 direction B (2026-11-10): mischievous magical heist, acoustic, more tension than the base track.
tracks.prompt: Loopable free-spins music for a premium pirate ghost crypt slot game, 60 seconds, A minor, 120 BPM, 4/4. A mischievous magical heist in a haunted treasure vault: tight pizzicato and staccato string ostinatos, col legno ticks like a clock, a sly celesta and harpsichord melody with a catchy minor hook, frame drums, low toms and a shaker driving it forward, muted brass stabs, a whispering wordless ghost choir and a low pipe organ pedal underneath. Playful tension that keeps building excitement, clever and sneaky, constant momentum without breakdowns. No electronic music: no synths, no synth bass, no EDM or four-on-the-floor kick, no claps, no dance beat, nothing like a rave. Not cartoonish: no tuba, no accordion. Spooky but classy, never horror. Clean modern film-score mix with room for game sounds. Seamless loop: the end flows back into the beginning. Instrumental only.
